collectionunit.notes: Samples between 600-658 cm are from a core taken in June 1963 by pushing an inflexible plastic pipe in the surface sediments. Samples between 665-1495 cm are from an 840cm core (named Core I) taken in March 1963 with a Hiller sampler.
collectionunit.location: 38m northwest of southeast end of lake

chronology.notes: Long core and short core combined. 4 C-14 dates from yet another core. TW assigned dates to long core, so depths for dates are approximate. Ragweed rise above 618cm. One date was rejected by Kapp and was not used. 10k date set for 1325cm to avoid Picea os
